[Act: constitution
 Chapter: Temporary, Transitional and Special Provisions
 Section: 390::Money received or raised or expenditure incurred between the commencement of the Constitution and the 31st day of March, 1950
]


Omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956, s. 29 and Sch. (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).
